name: @woohaa3/contracts
description: Woohaa3 cross-runtime contracts — versioned DTOs, runtime schemas, stable error codes and side-effect-free codecs shared by frontend, canvas-service, task-service and media-service. Browser-safe: no Node drivers, COS SDK, provider SDK or Yjs server.

scripts.build: node ../scripts/build-package.mjs && node ../scripts/build-package.mjs --entry src/canvas/yjs/index.ts --outdir dist/canvas-yjs --platform neutral && node ../scripts/build-package.mjs --entry src/extension/index.ts --outdir dist/extension && node ../scripts/build-package.mjs --entry src/extension/plugin.ts --outdir dist/extension --entry-name plugin && node ../scripts/build-package.mjs --entry src/extension/service.ts --outdir dist/extension --entry-name service && node ../scripts/build-package.mjs --entry src/theme/index.ts --outdir dist/theme
